description: Gift tax in the Netherlands for 2026: the yearly exemption for children and others, the one-time raised exemption (general or for study) for a recipient aged 18-40, the rates per relationship and whether a gift tax return must be filed. The recipient pays; Dutch tax applies when the giver lives in the Netherlands.

amount.description: Total given by this giver this year (both parents count as one giver), euros

giver_lives_in_netherlands.description: The giver lives in the Netherlands. Default true.

one_time_exemption.description: Claim the one-time raised exemption. Default none.

recipient_aged_18_to_40.description: The recipient (or their partner) is 18-40 on the day of the gift. Default false.

relationship.description: The recipient is the giver's child, grandchild, or anyone else

name: gift_tax_netherlands
title: Dutch gift tax (schenkbelasting)
